original_value: Compact multi-device desktop charger with 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A port, using GaN efficiency for cool operation and a detachable power cord. Designed for travel desks, studio setups, and everyday charging of phones, tablets, earbuds, and laptops that support USB-C power delivery.

result.paraphrase: Compact desktop charger for multiple devices with two USB-C ports and one USB-A port, featuring GaN efficiency for cooler operation plus a detachable power cord. Built for travel desks, studio setups, and everyday charging of phones, tablets, earbuds, and USB-C power delivery laptops.
